name: akt
description: Pinned Akash CLI for offline SDL validation and separately authorized network operations
installHint: vrooli host install akt delegates pinned source/akt acquisition to Scenario Dependency Analyzer; executable selection is returned by the akt owner

storage.rationale: Checksum-verified immutable release tree and receipt, also attributed in the native install ledger. Wallets and contexts belong to the caller's separate custody owner.

targets.unsupported: Upstream has an arm64 release, but this pinned owner profile has only qualified Linux amd64.
This pinned owner profile has not qualified macOS.
This pinned owner profile has not qualified Windows.

notes: Apache-2.0 upstream. No install script, context, key, wallet, transaction or public deployment is created. Caller must resolve and verify the selected installation before execution; no ambient PATH adoption.
